svg.title: Media Studio target: independent audio and video production over reusable speech libraries
svg.desc: Approved implementation target, not a completed migration. One WPF and Blazor Hybrid app calls typed libraries directly. Two thin smart-tool CLIs expose transcription and production, with audio and video capabilities in the same production tool. Shared reviewed content branches into a self-contained audio script or a video storyboard. Independent audio production creates a playable master, transcript and integrity manifest without the video core, visual providers, Node or a video encoder. Video production composes visuals, narration and captions. Both can consume reusable text-to-speech and transcription libraries where needed. Generation requires exact-revision, output-set authorization and durable admission through the existing tracked producer. Audio and video artifacts retain distinct outcomes. Aspire orchestrates resources; Jellyfin publication and native audio semantic search are separate, unverified boundaries.
svg.text: APPROVED TARGET / IMPLEMENTATION AND VERIFICATION IN PROGRESS
Audio and video are peers. Speech is a shared capability.
One sample repository. One Hybrid app. Two smart tools. No required internal MCP hop.
WPF + Blazor Hybrid
Create: text / voice + Audio / Video / Both
Script / Storyboard | Jobs | Projects / Artifacts
Direct typed library calls; in-process AG-UI
Voice input is separate from finished audio production.
Copilot / terminal: two thin smart tools
Production CLI: audio and video capabilities
audio-transcriber CLI: audio to timestamped text
System.CommandLine in adapters, not capability libraries.
Existing video commands stay compatible; no third TTS CLI.
Shared authoring and explicit production authority
Brief + audience + teaching objective + sources + claims + provenance
Model proposes; C# validates; human applies edits. Apply is not Generate.
Saved revision + reviewed medium-specific plans + output set + voice/providers + bounds
Approve & Generate -> durable admission -> existing tracked producer; navigation does not cancel it.
Independent audio production
Self-contained spoken script / listening sequence
Validated takes + deliberate pacing + actual sample clock
Playable audio master + transcript + integrity manifest
No video Core, dummy scenes, image/SVG decisions or capture.
No Node / HyperFrames / video encoder requirement.
Video production
Storyboard + narration + supported visual treatment
Trusted visuals / captures + measured timing + captions
Playable video + transcript/captions + integrity manifest
Keep existing video behavior and frozen requests.
External render workers are video-specific dependencies.
Reusable narration library
ITextToSpeechClient -> Kokoro -> measured PCM16 takes
Validated text / voice / language / speed / model provenance.
No dependency on video, CLI parsing, WPF or MAF.
Reusable transcription library
ISpeechToTextClient -> Whisper -> actual text segments
UI voice calls this directly; media analysis uses it when needed.
STT is not TTS; no mandatory transcription of every script.
Both: related plans, not necessarily identical narration. Reuse takes only when approved identities match.
Track each requested output. Preserve successful artifacts on partial failure; do not claim Both completed when one failed.
.NET 11 owns application code; Process APIs serve genuine executables, not a mandatory UI-to-CLI bridge.
One Aspire AppHost composes resources and pinned Jellyfin; its loaded plugin must still match the server runtime.
Setup, model downloads, live cloud calls and publication are separately gated. Jellyfin audio indexing is not yet established.
